expectations.evidence: The disqualifying rules target the specific exploit this event faces: an API bolted on with one clean call in the last hour, as with last edition's second-place team. Four rules are built against that path: (1) the core feature must break without the API rather than fall back to a mock; (2) a midpoint check-in at hour 24 needs a working commit, and teams with no logged key usage before it leave the track; (3) judges may revoke the API key during judging as a removal test; (4) a jump from near zero to a few calls in the final 3 hours gets extra scrutiny.
